backend: MPC signer with confirmation gate (Fireblocks x402_get_and_pay)
description: Correlation field, confirmation_predicate, and freshness window for an MPC-signer-with-gate backend, per docs/spec/guarantee-model.md "confirmation_predicate per backend" table (commit 66fd62f), pattern drawn from giskard09/fireblocks-action-ref-anchor. This is the vector that most needs stating explicitly: it is a NEGATIVE-adjacent case for a naive verifier — the backend's own 'confirmed' flag must NOT be read as the confirmation_predicate.
correlation_field: facilitator's transaction field from the PAYMENT-RESPONSE header
confirmation_predicate: same on-chain predicate as vector 03 (tx receipt exists and status == 1) — the confirmed flag in this backend is a PRE-EXECUTION approval gate, not the post-execution confirmation_predicate
anti_pattern_flagged: a verifier that treats Fireblocks' pre-execution 'confirmed: true' as proof of settlement is conflating two orthogonal axes (pre-execution approval strength vs post-execution confirmation_predicate strength) — this is the exact conflation guarantee-model.md warns against.

worked_example.provenance_disclaimer: SYNTHETIC — action_ref derived for a modeled x402_get_and_pay call based on fireblocks/x402-agent's public source (src/mcp-server.ts + src/HttpX402Service.ts). No real Fireblocks MPC signing or broadcast transaction beyond the anchor itself. No adoption or endorsement by Fireblocks is implied.

expect.predicate_holds_for_worked_example: reduces to vector 03 (on-chain) — the pre-execution confirmed flag is explicitly out of scope for this predicate
